findings.claim: 20-F FY2025：Vale 在亞洲鐵礦市場主要對手為 BHP、Rio Tinto、Fortescue；競爭因素為價格、品質、可靠度、營運與運輸成本。
findings.excerpt: Asia. Our main competitors in the Asian market are located in Australia and include subsidiaries and affiliates of BHP Group Limited (BHP), Rio Tinto Ltd (Rio Tinto) and Fortescue Metals Group Ltd.

findings.claim: 20-F FY2025：Vale 在全球客製銅精礦市場 2025 年份額約 2.8%；精煉銅陰極參與度屬邊際。
findings.excerpt: Our market share in 2025 was about 2.8% of the total custom copper concentrate market.

findings.claim: Wood Mackenzie 預期 Simandou 2026 年出口約 1,600 萬噸並續升，滿產 120 Mtpa 約占海運鐵礦近 7%；搜尋摘要稱巴西生產商（尤其 Vale）在品質上與其正面競爭（二手摘要，未核原文）。
findings.source: Wood Mackenzie 新聞稿 / Mining Weekly：Guinea's Simandou to become largest driver of seaborne iron ore supply growth

findings.claim: RBC 稱 Vale 為 Simandou 延遲的「clear winner」，預期其高階產品溢價擴大。
findings.source: itiger/Bloomberg: Vale Emerges as 'Clear Winner' From Simandou Delay, RBC Says
findings.excerpt: Vale Emerges as 'Clear Winner' From Simandou Delay, RBC Says MT Newswires Live 2025/12/11
